caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a stylized rooster, rendered in shades of dark brown and black. The rooster is shown in profile, facing left, with simplified and rounded body shapes. The comb and wattle are prominently visible, and the eye is illustrated with a circular pattern. The body features textured, arc-like lines suggesting feathers, while the tail is large, fan-shaped, and decorated with concentric, curved lines. A small circular hole appears near the end of the tail. The rooster stands on a rectangular base, and the background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details.
title: Windmill Counterbalance
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
